query:
SELECT a.award_id, a.source_award_no, a.title, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.total_amount
FROM award a
WHERE a.inst_id = @inst_id AND a.start_date <= @today AND a.end_date >= @today
ORDER BY a.end_date DESC
LIMIT 100
